name: Squared Away — Optional Bodycam + DLSS + Frame Generation
body:
**Player downloads:** [Full engine runtime](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/releases/download/bodycam-dlss-fg-2026.10.18/Squared.Away.Engine.Bodycam.DLSS.FG.DX11.AVX.zip) · [Required MO2 FG UI/scope patch](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/releases/download/bodycam-dlss-fg-2026.10.18/Squared.Away.FG.UI.Scope.Patch.zip) · [Optional NR reinstall pack](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/releases/download/bodycam-dlss-fg-2026.10.18/Squared.Away.Optional.DLSS5.NR.Runtime.zip). The full runtime already includes NR; the optional pack is redundant for a full installation.

# Squared Away + Bodycam + DLSS + Frame Generation

Optional DX11-AVX engine package, version `bodycam-dlss-fg-2026.10.18`.
Keep Squared Away installed. This is an additional experimental option; the
standard, Bodycam-only and Bodycam+DLSS options remain available.

This release combines the unchanged Test 8 automatic-start engine with the
patched NR 0.8.91 companion. Fomok confirms the combination works in game.
That confirmation does not establish every scope, visual setting or long session.
No FPS gain is guaranteed; neural rendering adds GPU work and can reduce rendered FPS.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, or Windows 11; 64-bit OS and AVX-capable CPU.
- NVIDIA RTX 40/50-series for this native 2x FG path, with a compatible current
  NVIDIA driver. Locally tested on RTX 5080 / driver 617.14. SDK capability checks
  decide availability; this is not an RTX 20/30 FG unlock or AMD FG package.
- Enable Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling in Windows Settings > System >
  Display > Graphics > default graphics settings, then restart Windows.
  See [NVIDIA requirements](https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline/blob/main/docs/ProgrammingGuideDLSS_G.md#10-requirements).
- Use DX11-AVX, SDR/windowed or compatible borderless presentation, MSAA off,
  and active temporal upscaling. Exclusive fullscreen/unsupported formats fall
  back to native presentation. DLSS/DLAA is the tested NR configuration.
- GAMMA shader setup: SSS 23.5, your actual Atmospherics version, and the two
  compatibility patches linked below. Select add-ons only when installed.

NR is a separate experimental feature of the supplied OptiScaler fork, using the
included 310.8 compatibility model. Its availability depends on the driver/runtime.
The model is modified, not an unmodified NVIDIA-signed DLL. The engine's six
Streamline/DLSS-G runtime DLLs retain their verified NVIDIA signatures.

## Installation

1. Close the game and MO2. Back up the existing `bin`, `db/mods`, OptiScaler INI
   and enabled shader/UI patch setup. Preserve a working complete engine package.
2. Extract **Squared.Away.Engine.Bodycam.DLSS.FG.DX11.AVX.zip** into the Anomaly
   game folder, merging its `bin` and `db` folders together. Do not install this
   runtime ZIP as an MO2 mod. It includes the tested engine, patched companion,
   clean configuration, SR/NR models and Streamline; no earlier test package is needed.
3. Keep one OptiScaler proxy only: the supplied `bin/dxgi.dll`. Back up and move
   out an older OptiScaler proxy under another name; do not remove unrelated
   ReShade/mod loaders blindly. Back up and move out obsolete
   `bin/nvngx.dll_dlssnr.dll`. **Keep `bin/nvngx_dlssnr.dll`**, the actual NR model.
   Replace the supplied INI or carefully merge personal tuning while preserving
   `[FrameGen] External=true`, `Enabled=false`, and `[Menu] OverlayMenu=false`.
4. Install [Bodycam GAMMA Patch 1.1.0](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/releases/download/bodycam-dlss-2026.10.18/Bodycam.GAMMA.Patch.1.1.0.zip)
   and [Bodycam DLSS Grass Motion Shader Patch](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/releases/download/bodycam-dlss-2026.10.18/Bodycam.DLSS.Grass.Motion.Shader.Patch.zip)
   through MO2. In the shader installer select SSS 23.5 and your installed
   Atmospherics version (or None); choose only installed optional add-ons.
   Put the shader patch below Bodycam, SSS and Atmospherics so it wins conflicts.
   Disable overlapping older DLSS/FSR compatibility patches.
5. Install **Squared.Away.FG.UI.Scope.Patch.zip** through MO2, below those patches
   and any older personal FG UI/shader mod. It must win these exact loose files:
   `gamedata/scripts/modxml_dlss_options.script`,
   `gamedata/configs/text/eng/st_monolith_dlss.xml`, and
   `gamedata/shaders/r3/scope_reference_image.ps`.
   Verify their winning provider in MO2's Data/conflict view. Loose files override
   packed DB files; the grass patch contains an older UI script/XML, so the final
   FG patch is required even though matching copies are packed in the runtime.
6. If upgrading old personal tests, back up and remove their obsolete
   `db/mods/zzzz_personal_fg_test7.db0` (or other specifically identified older FG
   override). This release replaces `zzzz_personal_fg_test8.db0`; do not leave
   duplicate renamed copies or delete unrelated archives. Clear the shader cache
   through the launcher after installing/changing shader patches.
7. Launch your ordinary shortcut > MO2 > Play using DX11-AVX. No special launcher,
   environment variable or command-line opt-in is required.

## Optional DLSS5 / NR reinstall pack

**Squared.Away.Optional.DLSS5.NR.Runtime.zip** contains only `bin/dxgi.dll`,
`bin/OptiScaler.ini`, `bin/nvngx_dlss.dll` and `bin/nvngx_dlssnr.dll`: the tested
patched companion, compatible settings, SR runtime and actual NR model. The full
FG engine runtime already contains these exact files. **Install the full engine
package OR use this optional pack to repair/reinstall NR on that matching setup;
there is no need to install both.** The optional ZIP does not supply an engine,
Streamline or shader/UI patches and is not a universal stock-engine injector.

For the optional pack, close the game/MO2, back up those four files and any old
helper, merge its `bin` into the matching Anomaly folder, keep the tested external-FG
INI settings, and move obsolete `nvngx.dll_dlssnr.dll` out after backup. Retain
the existing engine, Streamline and matching MO2 patches. Launch normally, then
use Insert to enable/disable NR. Restore the backed-up files/helper to undo it.
Engine FG/PiP controls remain in Video settings. A main-runtime update can replace
these same files again; do not stack duplicate proxies or alternate NR versions.

## In game

In Video > Basic, turn MSAA off, select DLSS/DLAA and its quality mode, and Apply.
Set **NVIDIA frame generation** to **On (2x)** and Apply. **Frame generation inside
PiP scopes** separately enables interpolation for supported Bodycam Reference
optics. PiP Off suspends FG while scoped; unsupported legacy scopes, NV/thermal,
loading, menus and unsafe UI can also suspend it. Cancel preserves saved choices.

Press Insert for OptiScaler/NR controls; enable its FPS Overlay if desired. Keep
OptiScaler's own FG disabled and its presentation overlay disabled: the engine
owns FG. Rendered/Presented counters report actual runtime counts, not a fixed
multiplier or physical monitor scan-out. The frame limit targets presented output:
100 with active FG means roughly 50 rendered plus 50 generated; off means 100 rendered.
The provided INI starts with pre-SR NR on, one pass, and leaves new finished-picture,
compression and debug modes off. NR can be disabled separately if its cost is unwanted.

If FG says unavailable, check GPU/driver/HAGS, presentation mode, MSAA and shader
overrides, then fully restart. Unsupported startup falls back to native DX11.
The existing `-dxgi_old` switch is an optional recovery route, not required normally.

## Rollback

Close the game. Restore the backed-up complete engine bin/db and companion INI,
including the old helper if that prior companion needed it. Disable the new FG
UI/scope patch and restore the previous shader/UI priority. Remove this release's
FG override DB if the restored package does not contain it; clear shader cache
after reverting shaders. Do not mix an old executable with new packed/UI files.

## Source, notices and validation

- Engine binary: [fa1b97c3](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/tree/fa1b97c3c85bd2bfb1704dc937e2fe7ce4d09169),
  [build 39147479433](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/actions/runs/39147479433).
- Companion: [personal patch dadc010c](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/tree/dadc010c8de129dfa28efd8f2fa11b64271029a1/tools/optiscaler)
  on [NR fork f45ccf3a / release 0.8.91](https://github.com/wilsjo2/OptiScaler-DLSSNR-PreSR-Multipass/tree/f45ccf3a761df91450959d325ac0166cba5364c9),
  [build 39151582217](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/actions/runs/39151582217).
- This release supplies a separate **OptiScaler.NR.0.8.91.Corresponding.Source.zip**
  containing the complete patched GPL source and pinned submodules, and
  **LICENSES-AND-NOTICES.txt** with redistribution notices. These are compliance
  materials, not the private engine developer merge kit. The developer merge ZIP
  is not published. Runtime files and their source/model provenance are listed in
  **runtime-manifest.json**. Keep the license notices with redistributed copies.

Automatic-start/fallback, GPU inputs, telemetry and settings checks passed for
the engine. The final companion passed NR diagnostics, eight cleanup cycles and
a foreground 1,800-frame NR/FG/menu run (1,360 two-present reports; 3,160 total SDK
presentations). Initial shutdown crashes were fixed before delivery; focus-lost
tests are preserved as failures, not generation passes. Public packaging only
changes two UI descriptions to remove obsolete wording; the script and scope
shader behavior and both tested binaries are unchanged. Packed UI CRC/payloads,
loose overrides, binary hashes and archive contents are verified before publishing.

name: Squared Away — Optional Bodycam + DLSS / FSR 3
body:
Optional Squared Away + Bodycam 0.3 engine with DLSS, DLAA and FSR 3 Super Resolution. DX11-AVX only; no frame generation. Includes the PiP scope fix, instanced grass and camera-motion fallback. Standard Bodycam handling; no personal weapon-follow or pivot changes.

Install the engine ZIP's **bin and db/mods together** into Anomaly. Keep Squared Away installed.

For GAMMA, install **Bodycam GAMMA Patch 1.1.0** and **Bodycam DLSS Grass Motion Shader Patch** through MO2. Put our shader patch below Bodycam, SSS and Atmospherics so it wins conflicts. Requires SSS 23.5; select your Atmospherics version in the installer. Disable previous DLSS/FSR compatibility patches. Clear shader cache and keep MSAA off.

Enable DLSS/FSR and select quality in Video settings. DLSS/DLAA requires NVIDIA RTX; FSR requires D3D feature level 11.1. No FPS gain is guaranteed. Tested by Fomok with DLSS and Bodycam scope effects. Existing engine options remain available.

Report issues in the [Discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/912320241713958912/1542887991222206484).

name: Squared Away + Bodycam 0.3
body:
Squared Away + Bodycam 0.3, based on the October 16 Bodycam release. Includes the new camera, weapon handling and scope improvements with Squared Away inventory support.

- **DX11-AVX only.** Install both `bin` and `db/mods` from the engine ZIP.
- **GAMMA:** also install Bodycam GAMMA Patch 1.1.0. Follow its included instructions, replace the older PiP compatibility patches and clear the shader cache.
- Keep your Squared Away mod. Standard-engine users do not need this update.

Uses the original Bodycam camera pivot; the experimental pivot changes are not included.

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

name: Squared Away — Engine Update 2026.10.11
body:
Updates both Squared Away engines to mrdemonized’s **2026.10.11** release, including upstream rendering, weapon and scripting fixes.

- **All DX:** standard engine, all eight renderer variants.
- **Bodycam:** optional combined engine, DX11-AVX only.

Keep **Squared Away 2.0.6 Hotfix 4**. Back up your current engine files, then install **both `bin` and `db/mods`** from your chosen ZIP into Anomaly. No new game is required.

Saving and changing areas were tested with bolts in a rig and items in boxes. **There may still be issues I didn’t catch. If anything is wrong, please report it in the [Discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/912320241713958912/1542887991222206484) and go back to the matching standard or Bodycam engine from the [2.0.3 post](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/releases/tag/v2.0.3). Restore both its `bin` and `db/mods` files.**

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads) · [Upstream changes](https://github.com/themrdemonized/xray-monolith/releases/tag/2026.10.11)

name: Squared Away 2.1.0 Minor Update
body:
# 2.1.0 Minor Update

### New items

- Artifacts Bag
- Small Artifact Bag
- Tall Mag Pouch — adds one tall magazine slot
- Advanced Tall Mag Pouch — adds two tall magazine slots

### Texture edits

- Patrontash
- Razvedka Sling
- Hip Pouch
- Pistol Case
- Field Medical Case

### Texture repositions

- Barakholka Rig
- 6Sh92 Surplus Rig
- Tarzan-M22
- Shturm Carrier
- Rubezh Carrier

Install the full ZIP with your usual compatibility options. Includes all earlier 2.0.6 hotfixes. **No engine update or new game required when updating from 2.0.x.**

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

## Optional stash grid test 2

Fixed-capacity stash grids with a **Sort stash** button. Test 2 fixes task-stash markers staying on the map after looting. The fix has been tested in-game by Fomok.

Download **Squared.Away.Stash.Grid.Optional.Test.2.zip**. Install below Squared Away 2.1.0 and its compatibility patches in MO2. Replace/disable the previous stash-grid test and keep a backup save. Existing grid layouts can stay. Keep your current engine; no new game is needed.

**First-time stash-grid users: empty your stashes BEFORE enabling this optional test.** For a marker already stuck on an empty stash, put one item in and take it back out.

Saving/loading, area transitions and task-stash loot spawning were tested in the previous version. This remains an optional test; report issues in the [Discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/912320241713958912/1542887991222206484).

body:
Fixes the save crash caused by bolts stored in rig pockets, including a single bolt. Bolt counts and pocket placement are preserved when loading.

Install the full ZIP with your usual compatibility options. Disable the separate **Bolt Rig Save Test 1** patch if installed. Includes all earlier 2.0.6 hotfixes.

**No new game or engine update required.** Keep the standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

Fixes stretched backgrounds and misaligned inventory controls in ZONA on ultrawide screens. Included in **SOTA UI Compatibility (ZONA)**. Default UI, GAMMA compatibility and 16:9 layouts are unchanged.

Install the full ZIP and select your usual patches. Disable **ZONA Ultrawide Test 1** if installed. Includes both earlier stats hotfixes.

**No new game or engine update needed.** Keep the standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

Sry i forgot about that funcionality xD

Install the full ZIP with your usual patches. Disable the separate stats preview/stack test patches. **No new game or engine update needed.** Keep the standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

body:
Fixes expanded item stacks displaying over the new stats bars. The bars and their tooltips now hide while a stack is open and return when it closes.

Download the full mod ZIP and choose your usual compatibility patches. Disable the separate Stats Stack Fix Test patch if installed. **No new game, engine update or add-on redownload needed.** Keep your standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

name: Squared Away 2.0.6 - Clearer inventory stats
body:
Optional new inventory stats with slim coloured bars, full names and a roomier layout. Supports default UI and GAMMA/ZONA SOTA, including vertical weapons.

Enabled by default; turn off **Use Squared Away slim stats bars** in **MCM > Squared Away > Appearance** to restore the original UI. This is a small visual update; you can skip it if you prefer your current layout.

![New stats panel](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/assets/patch-notes/stats-2.0.6.png)

Replace the full mod ZIP, select your usual patches and disable separate stats test mods. **Keep the 2.0.3 engine. Existing 2.0.x saves work.**

name: Squared Away - 2.0.3 Ammo Hotfix
body:
Fixes loose ammunition being consumed and recreated when reloading magazine-fed weapons, including the early-reload interaction with Dynamic Reload Speeds.

Install the **2.0.3 mod and matching engine**, then select the optional **Mags Reloaded ammo fix** in FOMOD. Requires Mags Reloaded Fork by Priler UPDATE 6 and its Dynamic Reload Speeds dependency. Let Squared Away win their file conflicts in MO2.

Existing 2.0.x saves work. Normal loose-ammo weapons, grenade launchers and magazine loading retain their usual behavior.

- **2.0.3.zip** — full mod with installer.
- **Engine - All DX.zip** — standard engine and matching DB0.
- **Engine - Bodycam.zip** — alternative for Bodycam users, DX11-AVX only.
- **For Developers.zip** — engine merge sources and diff.

[Downloads, installation guide and patch-note history](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/)

name: Squared Away - 2.0.2
body:
Equip weapons straight from dead bodies, even with a full backpack. Weapon swaps return the replaced weapon to the body. Works without the optional looting patch.

The optional Tarkov-like looting layout now has Field Kit equipment slots, a Pockets divider and remembered item positions and rotations.

**Install both the 2.0.2 mod and matching engine (including DB0). Existing 2.0 / 2.0.1 saves work; no new game needed.**

- **2.0.2.zip** — full mod with installer.
- **Engine - All DX.zip** — required engine, all eight DX/AVX variants.
- **Engine - Bodycam.zip** — optional combined engine for Bodycam users, DX11-AVX only. Use instead of the standard engine; install both bin and db/mods from this ZIP.
- **For Developers.zip** — merge files and full engine diff; not needed to play.

Upgrading from a version before 2.0 requires a new game.

[Installation guide, editor and patch notes](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/)

**Optional Bodycam engine — October 5, 2026**
Based on [Bodycam 2026.8.4](https://github.com/asuparabekon/xray-monolith-bodycam/releases/tag/2026.8.4-bodycam-mt), combined with Squared Away 2.0.2. Keep the 2.0.2 mod installed. For PiP scopes, follow Bodycam’s requirements for the matching external 3DSS PiP patch. Standard-engine users do not need this download.
